actor.description: Who caused the chain this event belongs to

audience.description: The grant names that may read the event; absent: everyone

basis.description: The highest seq the actor had seen when it decided; on `activation_opened` and `tool_called` only

causedBy.description: The seq this event is a consequence of; always smaller than `seq`

payload.description: The event's data, as its declared schema describes it

seq.description: The commit order: from 1, no gaps

tool.description: The canonical tool name of the call this event was written in

type.description: The event type: bare, unique within its source
